posts.name: Escher
posts.cooked:
I definitely agree with Setback as a himbo, but you only got to the point near the end: Legacy and Haka are hunks, not himbos.

To be a himbo you have to have three elements:

  • Pure of heart
  • Hot of bod
  • Dumb of ass

The first point is crucial. Ansel G Moreau can never be a true himbo because no matter how hot and dumb he is, he will never be pure-hearted. Same goes for Ra.

Legacy and Haka aren’t himbos; they just aren’t dumb enough. To be dumb of ass, you have to occasionally just stare at them and go “How are you that dumb?!” and I just don’t see it with these guys.

Thor is a himbo. Hulk is not.

talking about Muppets and classic lit I would recommend Boom Comics Muppet Robinhood. Kermit as Robin and Piggy as Marrion obviously. Sam Eagle as the Sheriff “the ignorant peasants need a strong hand to guide them”
Big, interesting twist is Fozzie as Tuck- he is not a mendicant friar, but Prince John’s court jester sent to infiltrate the merry men. so we get a betrayal and redemption arc. his redemption quest is to find immortal crusader knights to help fight evil
“ho-ho who were you expecting bear?”
also when Richard Lionheart shows up it is Pepe - “I told chu I was a King Prawn m’kay”
